notes:
Background notifications now run silently without a persistent keep-alive notification.

Moagram keeps its background push connection active in memory and checks for messages in the background without placing an ongoing service notification in your notification shade.
critical_message: This update reports anonymous active use: a random install id and the app version, at most once a day. Your Telegram account, phone number, and messages stay on this phone. You can turn it off under Settings → Moagram Updates → Count this install.
